name: Cyber Wrestling Exhibition Match

date.source: The post's own subject line and posting date.

matches.note: Non-sanctioned exhibition match, no time limit rules stated beyond a twenty-minute limit; won by submission ("The Dead Lock").

notes: The fed's own recruitment-drive exhibition match, staged to advertise ahead of its announced (never-confirmed) first Pay-Per-View, Cyber Combat. A ring announcer (Ted Fitsgeral), two commentators (Chris Figoro, Anastasia Osborne) and a cameo (The All-Star Wrestler) are named in the served page text but not separately minted.
